notes: BACKUP AND RESTORE. Export data (Edit balances, bottom row) now downloads ledger-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json. The file wraps the whole plan, the same object saved to the cloud, with app name, format, app version, export time and counts. Preview screen-state is left out. NEW: Import data, next to Export. It replaces everything in the current account after a confirmation summary, and first downloads ledger-backup-before-import-YYYY-MM-DD.json of the data being replaced, so the step can be undone. NEW: the first setup screen of an account with no plan offers 'Import a backup', so a new email or device can load an existing plan and skip setup. Both use one routine: parseLedgerBackup checks it is JSON, a Ledger plan (stateHasData) and under the 1 MB single-document limit. applyLedgerBackup runs migrateState, then the same one-time housekeeping as a normal sign-in (_afterStateLoaded, moved out of enterApp so it is not duplicated), saves to the account immediately rather than waiting for the debounce, and opens the app. Raw state files from the previous Export button still import. A backup made by a newer version is imported with a warning. Import replaces; it does not merge. Device preferences (theme, number pad) are not part of the plan and do not travel. VERIFIED in headless Chromium through the real buttons and file picker, with a stand-in for the cloud save: 29 checks. They cover: export contents; new-account import (summary, cancel leaves setup untouched, accept opens the app and saves to the NEW account id, every projected number identical to the source); the older raw format; clear messages for non-JSON, non-Ledger and oversized files; the newer-version note; replace (warning text, cancel changes nothing, accept downloads the undo backup first then replaces and saves); export still fires once after a replace; round trip byte-identical on an up-to-date plan; phone layout of the setup box; no page errors. All earlier suites pass. NOT VERIFIED: a real Firebase save and sign-in on a second email (no network in the test environment). The guards sheetVsDash, decisionUsesChain, instrumentCrossPageMismatch and accountDeltaMismatches are not in the HTML file and were not run. NOT BUILT: closed-EMI zero row; settlement on its own line; Edit balances port and Instruments page deletion; Decisions/Scenarios merge.
